proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: After Jean dies at Alkali Lake, Scott breaks down on Logan's shoulder. Back at the school, Logan tells him that Jean made her choice, and it was Scott.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The man Jean chose. Logan tells him so after she dies.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Scott that Jean chose him.

changes.evidence: X2 ending: on the jet Scott falls crying on Logan as Jean drowns; in Xavier's study Logan tells Scott that Jean did make a choice, and it was Scott. The rivalry from X-Men (2000) turns into grudging respect; the fandom relationship list calls Wolverine a friend and former rival.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: Logan covers for the grieving Scott and urges him to move on from Jean. When Scott rides to Alkali Lake and is killed, Logan finds only his glasses.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A grieving teammate. Killed at Alkali Lake.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Urges Scott to move on, then finds only his glasses.

changes.evidence: The Last Stand: in the hallway Logan tells Scott he covered for him and that it may be time to move on; Scott rides to Alkali Lake, where Jean kills him, and Logan and Storm find only his glasses. A death is a stage under the owner's rules.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: Storm and Logan find Jean alive at Alkali Lake and bring her home, but as the Phoenix she turns on the X-Men and leaves with Magneto.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Brings Jean home from Alkali Lake.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Returns as the Phoenix and turns on the X-Men.

changes.evidence: The Last Stand: Xavier sends Logan and Storm to Alkali Lake, where they find an unconscious Jean and bring her to the mansion; the Phoenix escapes, kills Xavier and leaves with Magneto, and later attacks everyone at Alcatraz.

proposed.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
proposed.text: In Paris, Hank helps stop Raven from killing Trask. When Erik tries to kill her, Hank fights him off so she can escape.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fights off Erik to save Raven in Paris.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The woman Hank saves from Erik in Paris.

changes.evidence: Days of Future Past (1973): Xavier, McCoy and Logan foil Mystique's attempt on Trask at the Paris Peace Accords; Magneto tries to kill her and McCoy fights him, allowing Mystique to escape. The connection starts here, before the Apocalypse stage.

owner_calls.question: In X-Men: First Class (1962), Charles and Erik approach Logan in a bar to recruit him and he rudely tells them off. Should this brief cameo be an earlier stage of Logan and Xavier's connection?
options: No stage: a ten-second refusal, nothing more passes between them
Add a first stage at X-Men: First Class (e.g. rival: 'Charles tries to recruit Logan in a bar, and Logan tells him where to go.')
owner_calls.evidence: Uncredited cameo in a bar, rudely rejecting Xavier and Lehnsherr when they approach him for recruitment.
